en-GB.title: Pip: Poker
en-GB.subtitle: Texas Hold'em with friends
en-GB.description:
Pip is Texas Hold'em, redesigned. A quiet table, your friends when you want them, a cast of regulars who each play their own way, and an honest read on how you play.

Play money only. There is no real money anywhere in Pip: nothing to deposit, nothing to win, nothing to cash out. Chips are never for sale. No ads, and no forced pop-ups.

THE GAME IS FREE
• Climb a ladder of ten venues, from Friends' Garage to The Main Event.
• Cash games at the Rail. Sit down, stand up whenever.
• The Daily: the same cards for everyone, once a day.
• Challenge tables against the regulars, one at a time.
• A short, honest read on every hand as you finish it.
• Two starter drills: What have you got? and Which hand wins?
• One member table a day, without joining: Omaha and Short Deck included. It comes back at midnight UTC.
• Level 1 of Lessons with Webb, and every written guide.
• Join a friend's multiplayer room with a free account.
• Broke? Win your way back at the Kitchen Table.

A free account keeps your Roll on every device, and you never need one to play.

THE MEMBERSHIP
It adds:
• Multiplayer. Open a room, send your friends the code, and play at the same table, with your camera and microphone on if you like. Friends join free with a Pip account. Or make it a slow game, with an hour to a day for each move and the clock stopped in your quiet hours. Or quick match at any ladder stake, with AI players in any empty seat.
• Lessons with Webb, Levels 2 to 5. Interactive lessons on the real felt: Webb deals, stops to ask, and explains. Starting hands, position, outs, pot odds, stack sizes, ranges and bluffing.
• Every other drill, including Pot odds, Count your outs, Open or fold and Shove or fold.
• Session review. Every hand of your last session back on the felt, with each call and fold graded.
• Your report. Where your chips go, built from every hand you have played.
• The side tables: Omaha, Short Deck, Hi-Lo and Five-Card Draw, plus fast, heads-up, bounty and deep Hold'em.
• Build your own table.

Nothing you can buy changes a hand: not the cards, not the odds, not what you are shown.

The membership is monthly or yearly and renews automatically until you cancel. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Cancel any time in your App Store account settings, at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

OPEN SOURCE
Pip's code is public. Anyone can read how a hand is dealt and shuffled: github.com/playpip/pip-web

review.notes:
Pip is a Texas Hold'em game played with play money only. There is no real-money gambling of any kind: nothing can be deposited, won, cashed out or bought with chips, and chips are never sold. Most play is against computer players. Members can also play with their friends (MULTIPLAYER, below).

The app is a native shell around Pip's own web app at playpip.io. Natively it provides haptics shaped to every sound, Sign in with Apple, In-App Purchase with Restore Purchases, and its own screen when there is no connection. Links to other sites open in Safari, outside the app.

HOW TO REACH THINGS
• The app opens on the lobby. No sign-in is needed to play.
• Table: tap "Next up" (The Card Room or Friends' Garage) to sit down at a tournament.
• Lessons: lobby > "Learn with Webb" > any lesson in Levels 2 to 5.
• Drills: lobby > "Drills".
• Report and session review: tap your avatar (top left) > "Stats" > "Read the full report" or "Review your last session". Session review fills after you play a few hands.
• Side tables: lobby > "Side Tables".
• Multiplayer: lobby > "Multiplayer" (under Other ways to play).
• Sign in: Settings (gear icon, top right) > "Your account" > "Sign in", with the demo account below.
• Account deletion: Settings > "Your account" > "Manage account" > "Delete my account and synced data".

THE MEMBERSHIP
The core game (the ladder, cash games, the Daily) is free. The membership is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, sold in the app through In-App Purchase. Products: io.playpip.app.member.monthly and io.playpip.app.member.yearly. Membership page: lobby > any members-only item, or Settings > Membership > "What the membership is". Restore Purchases is on the same page. The demo account below is already a member, so every paid feature is unlocked when signed in. To see the free experience, use the app without signing in.

MULTIPLAYER
Private rooms are invitation only: a member opens a room and gets a six-character code, and only people they give it to can join. There is no public lobby, no text chat, and no way to message strangers. In a private room each player can turn on their camera and microphone, off by default, to see and talk to the friends at their table; video and audio go directly between the players' devices and are not recorded or stored. The camera and microphone permission prompts appear only when the player taps those buttons. Tapping any player opens Mute, Hide their camera, Report (stored with both accounts and the room for us to review) and Block (no camera or voice between the two from then on, and they cannot join rooms the blocker opens). The host can also remove any player, who then cannot rejoin. Quick match seats a member with other members at the same stake, has no camera, microphone or chat, and fills empty seats with computer players marked "AI".
To try it alone with the demo account: lobby > Multiplayer > Quick match > Find a table. Computer players fill the table after about 30 seconds. To see a private room, tap Create a room > Open the room, then join from a second device with the code shown, signed in with any account.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Email and password are in the Sign-In Information fields. This account has an active membership. To test buying, sign in with any other account and use a sandbox Apple ID.
